meta.source: MoSPI, National Statistical Office (Annual Survey of Industries)
meta.revisionPolicy: ASI results are final on release; occasional revisions get a fresh vintage.
meta.product: Annual Survey of Industries, NIC 2008 block
meta.coverage: Odisha by 2-digit NIC division, every indicator, 2008-09 to 2023-24 (NIC 2008 block)
meta.note: The NIC-2008 classification block, a separate ruler from every other block (never joined). Values as published: money in ₹ lakh (nominal; fuel values in ₹ thousand where the source says so), counts plain, mandays in thousands. Survey years are financial years, dated at April of the first. A class missing in a year was not reported separately that year. The 2023-24 four-digit copies of the All-industries rows of indicators 36 to 49 arrive shifted by one indicator; at All India they are outvoted by the clean 2- and 3-digit copies (see asi-accounts).
